text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We'd just finished today's training,
but Biko Pegasus was warming up for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! Today's the day
I finally master the Pegasus Tornado!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ehhh... but Trainer! A hero can't get stronger without intense training, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Even Carrotman gets help from
his friends, fighting 8-on-1 and stuff!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You get hit with a huge iron ball
and power up!
choice_data_list: This is way too spartan, even for tough training!?
Isn't that taking the whole spartan training thing way too far!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna train even harder!
'Cause I wanna get way faster!
choice_data_list: If you promise not to overdo it, I'll come with you.
Let's save it for next time!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
All riiight! Time for some extra training!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if I could handle
that iron ball training too?"
choice_data_list: I absolutely won't allow it, you hear!?
I absolutely won't allow it, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Okay, I'll hold back on that!
Running is fine, right!? I'm gonna run with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Biko Pegasus completed more training than usual.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! But I'm still bursting with energy!
I don't wanna hold back!
choice_data_list: Resting your body is also part of training!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Resting is part of special training...
How could that be...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! But Carrotman said it too!
Save up your strength and be ready for when the time comes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna go rest with everything I've got!
Uwooooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeming satisfied with the explanation,
Biko Pegasus energetically headed back to the dorms.
